periods.time: Two days before the tournament opening

name.zh: 破军代表抵达大阪宴会
name.en: Hagun Representatives Arrive at the Osaka Banquet

periods.location: contestant hotel near Osaka Bay Dome
periods.summary: Ikki and Shizuku prepare formal clothes for the representative banquet while Alice helps Shizuku and warns Ikki to beware of Akatsuki. Stella is absent because she continues last-minute training with Nene after losing to Ouma.
periods.cause: The Seven Stars committee holds a buffet banquet for early-arriving representatives.
periods.process: Shizuku reacts strongly to Ikki's half-dressed appearance, Alice takes a commemorative photo, and Ikki discusses Stella's intense training and enormous potential with Shizuku.
periods.outcome: Ikki enters the banquet expecting to study national rivals and realizes the competitors already recognize him as a serious threat.
periods.significance: Establishes the Seven Stars venue, Hagun's team mood, Stella's absence, and Ikki's status among national-class fighters.
